title: Sustainable and resource-efficient synthesis of zeolite membranes in a fluoride-free, organic template-free dilute solution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21859-21871
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03631C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Liangqing Li, Jiajia Li, Yang Li, Xinyu Wu, Liangsong Li, Wenhao Zeng, Yajun Chen, Jungkyu Choi
A green and sustainable method was developed to prepare a high-performance mordenite membrane on a low-cost macroporous tube under fluoride-free and template-free conditions using a highly diluted synthesis solution for isopropanol dehydration.
